Name: Billboard Profit Margin
Author: JustToDownloadThings
Description:
[b]Compatible[/b][b] with:[/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4663]Profit Margins[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2644]Help Wanted Quest Fixes[/url]

[b]Installation[/b]
- Download the mod zip
- Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
- Unzip the mod into Stardew Valley's Mods folder

[b]Configuration[/b]
- [code]UseProfitMargin: bool[/code] = (Pierre's) Use the profit margin ([code]true[/code]), or use the custom amount ([code]false[/code])
- [code]CustomQuestMargin: float[/code] = (Pierre's) Multiplier for quest rewards. [code]1.0[/code] = no change, [code]0.5[/code] = half, [code]2.0[/code] = double
- [code]UseProfitMarginForSpecialOrders: bool[/code] = (Lewis') Use the profit margin ([code]true[/code]), or use the custom amount ([code]false[/code])
- [code]CustomProfitMarginForSpecialOrders: float[/code] = (Lewis') Multiplier for quest rewards. [code]1.0[/code] = no change, [code]0.5[/code] = half, [code]2.0[/code] = double

[b]Existing save[/b]

This mod can be used on an existing save. Already accepted quests won't be updated, however. It will only apply to newly accepted ones.

[b]Source[/b]
Over on [url=https://github.com/desto-git/sdv-mods/tree/master/BillboardProfitMargin]GitHub[/url]

Manifest.Name: Billboard Profit Margin
Manifest.Description: Profit margin for daily quest rewards.
